author: KEXP
description: From the stoner rock underground of the 90s to becoming one of the leading heavy rock bands of the 21st century, Queens Of The Stone Age remain sharp in their craft. Our latest in-studio session invites the legendary band in to share a performance of "Spinning In Daffodils" and more.
title: Queens Of The Stone Age performs Spinning In Daffodils" & more

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG presents Queens of the Stone Age performing live in the KEXP studio. Recorded April 28, 2026.

Songs:  
Someone's In The Wolf 01:10
Mosquito Song 10:30
Keep Your Eyes Peeled 16:35
Spinning In Daffodils 21:43
